acceptanceCriteria.text: Every test logs in as SystemTester; a test that needs a second person uses SystemTester2.

gateRef.assertion: grep test/ for any player token other than the two test users → 0 hits

acceptanceCriteria.text: No test uses the owner token, a real person's profile, or a freshly minted random user.

gateRef.assertion: list-test-pollution.mjs after a full run shows only the two test users

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test users are seeded with real device keys, not 'e2e-bypass'.
